# Rework round 3 claims (personal_loan_servicing)

PLS-R2-1: closed — the late-fee rule now says the pay-cycle form applies only to a loan on schedule_a or schedule_b, and a schedule_c loan's late-fee figure is its flat amount whatever the FlexLine shows. This is what compute does. Tier 2 now names the maximum of the loan's own schedule (the schedule_a or schedule_b maximum), so no tier needs a quantity that schedule_c lacks. The overwrite's replaced_by, the assembly sentence, the pay_cycle_form ladder (each tier scoped to schedule_a/schedule_b, with schedule_c in the fall-through) and the compute_basis quotes were all updated in the same pass. Compute is unchanged.
PLS-R2-1 class (every fee-schedule / state branch of every policy): closed. The late fee was probed per branch (schedule_a, schedule_b, schedule_c) and per pay-cycle tier, plus nothing past due on the FlexLine and no FlexLine late fee. The returned fee was probed per branch and per bank-event tier. Rule reading and compute agree on every probe. The returned-fee rule now states that on schedule_c every form works from that schedule's amount. The courtesy waiver's returned-fee prerequisite sentence and condition now require a fee schedule that charges for the return, because schedule_c writes no fee line. Every grade variant carries every grade parameter that any compute reads. The other three policies have no state or schedule branch.
R2-O1: closed — the pay-cycle tier-1 wording no longer calls the result one shared late charge. It says the loan's own late fee is cut to the loan's part of the two amounts past due in that cycle, with the FlexLine late fee left as charged. Tier 2 says the loan's late fee is held so that it and the FlexLine late fee stay within the loan's schedule maximum. The same class member in the returned fee was reworded too: "one bank event carrying two fees" and the ladder's "split by size" became the loan's own fee cut to the loan's part of that one bank event. The ladders, compute_basis quotes and task-1 trace and necessity text were swept.
R2-O2: closed — the refinance and AutoPay Credit Builder checks no longer string-match an amount in an equality filter. Each reads the active account's amount past due with CFIELD and compares it numerically to zero, with a None guard. The rule states that a borrower holds at most one active Credit Builder account (builder_agg_multi_holding) and that the amount is compared as an amount. A sweep of every compute expression found no other numeric value in an equality filter.
R2-O3: carried — unchanged; nothing scored depends on when the earlier returned-payment fees were booked.
R2-O4: carried — the second-tier cross-product offsets are kept as relief measures; their wording was tightened under R2-O1.
